mm07_gronwall.reference:
by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero => simp
  | succ k ih =>
    calc E (k + 1) ≤ (1 + α) * E k := h_step k
      _ ≤ (1 + α) * ((1 + α) ^ k * E 0) :=
          mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left ih (by linarith)
      _ = (1 + α) ^ (k + 1) * E 0 := by ring
